reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Full-source 15 fps whole-body and lower-body evidence was directly visually reviewed before any count was admitted.
reviewMethod.densePassReview: The PASS clip was rechecked at 10 fps across the full source and at 30 fps around start/end and the long cadence gap. Thirty completed takeoff/airborne/landing cycles were directly visually confirmed.
reviewMethod.locatorPolicy: Programmatic centroid/motion analysis was used only to suggest candidate timestamps. It did not decide type and did not generate the GT. One real cycle missed by the locator around 14.15 s was recovered by direct visual gap review.
reviewMethod.mixedTypePolicy: Any alternate-foot, boxer-step, high-knee, crossover, side-step, or other mixed subtype anywhere in the source rejects the clip from STANDARD.

rows.note: Opening 15 fps lower-body sequence immediately shows repeated unilateral support and alternating high-knee/running-step footwork. Not synchronized two-foot basic; no GT count admitted.

Full-source 15 fps whole-body/lower-body review confirmed synchronized two-foot uncrossed basic single-under throughout. Thirty completed cycles were directly visually verified. A locator suggested 29 candidate apexes after startup, but direct review of the 13.6-14.6 s cadence gap found one additional real completed cycle around 14.15 s; the final cycle near 15.08 s lands before the 15.315 s source boundary.
Full-source lower-body review shows repeated lateral/non-synchronized footwork with alternating support. Strict two-foot STANDARD purity fails; no GT count admitted.
